destination_verification: Exact copied-control and mapping union, object member bytes, inventory and private modes verified by a separately implemented checker.
limits: Exact approved closed scaling/ownswap scope only.
No semantic payload audit, experiment execution, scientific validation, full replayability or off-device backup claim.
Before/after integrity is a bounded observation, not continuous custody.
Unresolved unnamed trace references and packing, sparse and promotion dependencies remain explicit; a scalar hash without a path does not establish a missing file.
Other result/label custody remains with its separate owners.
source_verification: Every allowed source hash, size and recorded state checked before and after; byte equality required before deduplication. Access time is not a source-integrity field.
